# FlareMenu

`Flare.Components.FlareMenu`

A dropdown menu: an activator slot opens a panel of FlareMenuItem entries with arrow-key navigation and submenus, and a host can also open it at an explicit pointer position for a context menu it owns itself.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Kind | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Activation` | `MenuActivation` | `MenuActivation.LeftClick` | Parameter |  | How the menu opens from its activator. RightClick turns it into a context menu (and suppresses the browser's own menu). |
| `Activator` | `RenderFragment<FlareMenuActivatorContext>?` | `` | Parameter |  | Element that opens the menu when clicked. The slot receives a FlareMenuActivatorContext, whose Attributes belong on the focusable element inside it - <FlareButton @attributes="context.Attributes"> - so that the button a screen reader lands on is the one announcing the menu and whether it is open. |
| `Anchor` | `MenuAnchor` | `MenuAnchor.BottomLeft` | Parameter |  | Logical activator edge the panel aligns to. Start is right in RTL and left in LTR. |
| `AriaLabel` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Accessible label for the menu panel (role="menu"). |
| `ChildContent` | `RenderFragment?` | `` | Parameter |  | Menu items rendered inside the dropdown panel. Keyboard order follows the order the items mount. Reordering them with @key while the menu is OPEN is not supported: Blazor moves the existing components without re-registering them, so the rendered order changes and the arrow keys keep the previous sequence. Render the list in its final order before opening it. |
| `Dense` | `bool` | `false` | Parameter |  | Reduces item height/padding for a denser menu (consistent with other components' Dense). |
| `FreeContent` | `bool` | `false` | Parameter |  | Declares that the panel holds ordinary focusable content - buttons, fields, anything that answers the keyboard itself - rather than FlareMenuItem entries. A menu of items keeps the focus on the panel and moves a highlight over them, so it has to swallow the keys that would otherwise move the focus away; content that is focusable in its own right needs the opposite, and swallowing those keys would leave it reachable by nothing but Escape. Set this and the panel announces itself as a group instead of a menu and lets Tab, Enter and Space through. Escape still closes either way. |
| `MaxHeight` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Optional CSS max-height for the panel (e.g. "20rem"); a longer list scrolls instead of overflowing the viewport. |
| `OnToggle` | `EventCallback<bool>` | `` | Callback |  | Callback triggered whenever the menu open state changes. |
| `PositionAtCursor` | `bool` | `false` | Parameter |  | Opens the panel pinned to the pointer position instead of the activator corner - the expected behavior for a context menu. |
| `AdditionalAttributes` | `IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object>?` | `` | Parameter |  | Additional attributes. Inherited from `FlareComponentBase`. |
| `Class` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Additional CSS class(es) appended to the component's root element. Inherited from `FlareComponentBase`. |
| `Style` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Inline style string appended to the component's root element. Inherited from `FlareComponentBase`. |

## Methods

### `CloseAsync()`

Closes the menu (also callable programmatically), clears registered items and keyboard focus, and raises OnToggle.
Returns: `Task`.

### `CloseFromDismiss()`

Closes the menu when a pointer-down lands outside it or focus leaves it.
Returns: `Task`.

### `CloseFromEscape()`

Closes the menu when the overlay layer receives Escape.
Returns: `Task`.

### `OpenAsync()`

Opens the menu programmatically (no-op if already open) and raises OnToggle.
Returns: `Task`.

### `OpenAtAsync(double clientX, double clientY)`

Opens the menu with its panel pinned to a point in viewport coordinates - a pointer event's ClientX and ClientY - so a host that owns a shared context menu (the tree row's OnContextMenu, for example) can raise it without an activator of its own. No-op when the menu is already open. The point is honoured regardless of PositionAtCursor, which only governs the activator click. The panel otherwise opens like any other: the same placement engine flips and clamps it inside the viewport and raises it into the top layer, the backdrop and Escape close it, and a top-level menu in a FlareMenuBarContext joins the bar's coordination. Raises OnToggle. The panel takes focus like any other open. When it closes - unless an item's action moved focus elsewhere - focus returns to the element that held it before the menu opened, as long as that element is still in the document.
Returns: `Task`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `clientX` | `double` | Horizontal pointer position in CSS pixels from the viewport's left edge; the same value as MouseEventArgs.ClientX. |
| `clientY` | `double` | Vertical pointer position in CSS pixels from the viewport's top edge. |
